translations.literal: Ruzuo held that "there is still much grain in the storehouses; routed soldiers arrive daily from all four sides — these men have passed through a hundred deaths and, if roused, can all be used. The court relies on me to hold this prefecture, yet the supreme commander wants to abandon it — what sort of heart is that?"
translations.idiomatic: Ruzuo held that "there is still much grain in the storehouses; routed soldiers arrive daily from all four sides — these men have passed through a hundred deaths and, if roused, can all be used. The court relies on me to hold this prefecture, yet the supreme commander wants to abandon it — what sort of heart is that?"

sentences.zh: 讒間既行，有相圖之隙，詳議官楊鵬釋之曰：「外難未解而顧私忿。」

translations.literal: Once slander had taken effect there was room for mutual plotting. Review officer Yang Peng reconciled them, saying, "External peril is not yet resolved, yet you attend to private resentment."
translations.idiomatic: Once slander had taken effect there was room for mutual plotting. Review officer Yang Peng reconciled them, saying, "External peril is not yet resolved, yet you attend to private resentment."

sentences.zh: 語甚諄切。

translations.literal: His words were very earnest.
translations.idiomatic: His words were very earnest.

sentences.zh: 實乃還山，鵬因勸汝作納奏，乞死守此州，以堅軍民之心。

translations.literal: Shi then returned to the mountains. Peng therefore urged Ruzuo to submit a memorial begging to die defending this prefecture, to firm the hearts of army and people.
translations.idiomatic: Shi then returned to the mountains. Peng therefore urged Ruzuo to submit a memorial begging to die defending this prefecture, to firm the hearts of army and people.

sentences.zh: 其冬，戰於襄、郟，得馬百餘，士氣頗振，遂以汝作為總帥，不復與實相關矣。

translations.literal: That winter they fought at Xiang and Jia, took more than a hundred horses, and morale revived somewhat; Ruzuo was then made supreme commander and no longer had dealings with Shi.
translations.idiomatic: That winter they fought at Xiang and Jia, took more than a hundred horses, and morale revived somewhat; Ruzuo was then made supreme commander and no longer had dealings with Shi.

sentences.zh: 天興二年六月，哀宗在蔡州，遣使徵兵入援。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of Tianxing 2, Emperor Aizong was at Caizhou and sent envoys to summon troops for relief.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of Tianxing 2, Emperor Aizong was at Caizhou and sent envoys to summon troops for relief.

sentences.zh: 州人為邏騎所擾，農事盡廢，城中糧亦垂盡。

translations.literal: The people of the prefecture were harried by patrol cavalry; farming was entirely abandoned, and grain in the city was nearly exhausted.
translations.idiomatic: The people of the prefecture were harried by patrol cavalry; farming was entirely abandoned, and grain in the city was nearly exhausted.

sentences.zh: 是月，中京破，部曲私議有脣亡之懼，計以城降，懼汝作，不敢言，乃以遷州入山白之。

translations.literal: That month the Central Capital fell; his followers privately discussed fear of the lips being gone when the teeth grow cold, and planned to surrender the city. They feared Ruzuo and dared not speak openly, so they raised moving the prefecture into the mountains with him.
translations.idiomatic: That month the Central Capital fell; his followers privately discussed fear of the lips being gone when the teeth grow cold, and planned to surrender the city. They feared Ruzuo and dared not speak openly, so they raised moving the prefecture into the mountains with him.

sentences.zh: 汝作怒曰：「吾家父祖食祿百年，今朝延又以州事帥職委我，吾生為金民，死為金鬼。

translations.literal: Ruzuo said angrily, "For a hundred years my fathers and grandfathers ate the state's salary; now the court has again entrusted me with prefectural affairs and command. Living I am a Jin subject; dead I am a Jin ghost.
translations.idiomatic: Ruzuo said angrily, "For a hundred years my fathers and grandfathers ate the state's salary; now the court has again entrusted me with prefectural affairs and command. Living I am a Jin subject; dead I am a Jin ghost.

sentences.zh: 汝輩欲避於山，非欲降乎？

translations.literal: You wish to flee to the mountains — is that not wishing to surrender?
translations.idiomatic: You wish to flee to the mountains — is that not wishing to surrender?

sentences.zh: 有再言遷者吾必斬之。」

translations.literal: Whoever speaks of moving again, I will surely behead."
translations.idiomatic: Whoever speaks of moving again, I will surely behead."

sentences.zh: 八月，塔察將大兵攻蔡，經汝州。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, Tacha led a great army to attack Cai and passed through Ruzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, Tacha led a great army to attack Cai and passed through Ruzhou.

sentences.zh: 州人梁皋作亂，與故吏溫澤、王和七八人徑入州廨，汝作不為備，遂為所殺。

translations.literal: Liang Gao of the prefecture rebelled; with former clerks Wen Ze, Wang He, and seven or eight others he went straight into the prefectural office. Ruzuo was unprepared and was killed.
translations.idiomatic: Liang Gao of the prefecture rebelled; with former clerks Wen Ze, Wang He, and seven or eight others he went straight into the prefectural office. Ruzuo was unprepared and was killed.

sentences.zh: 時宣使石珪體究洛陽所以破及強伸死節事，以路阻，留汝州驛。

translations.literal: At that time Imperial Commissioner Shi Gui was investigating how Luoyang fell and how Qiang Shen died for principle; blocked by the roads, he stayed at the Ruzhou post station.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Imperial Commissioner Shi Gui was investigating how Luoyang fell and how Qiang Shen died for principle; blocked by the roads, he stayed at the Ruzhou post station.

sentences.zh: 梁皋既殺汝作，走告珪曰：「汝作私積糧斛，不恤軍民，眾怒殺之矣。

translations.literal: After Liang Gao killed Ruzuo, he ran to tell Gui, "Ruzuo privately hoarded grain and paid no heed to army and people; the crowd killed him in anger.
translations.idiomatic: After Liang Gao killed Ruzuo, he ran to tell Gui, "Ruzuo privately hoarded grain and paid no heed to army and people; the crowd killed him in anger.

sentences.zh: 皋不圖汝作官職，惟宣使裁之。」

translations.literal: Gao does not seek Ruzuo's office — let the imperial commissioner decide."
translations.idiomatic: Gao does not seek Ruzuo's office — let the imperial commissioner decide."

sentences.zh: 圭懼，乃以皋權汝州防禦使、行帥府事。

translations.literal: Gui was afraid and made Gao acting defense commissioner of Ruzhou to conduct marshal's office affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Gui was afraid and made Gao acting defense commissioner of Ruzhou to conduct marshal's headquarters affairs.

sentences.zh: 脫走入蔡，以皋殺汝作事聞。

translations.literal: He escaped to Cai and reported Gao's killing of Ruzuo.
translations.idiomatic: He escaped to Cai and reported Gao's killing of Ruzuo.

sentences.zh: 哀宗甚嗟惜之，遣近侍張天錫贈汝作昌武軍節度使，子孫世襲謀克，仍詔峴山帥呼延實、登封帥范真並力討皋。

translations.literal: Emperor Aizong deeply lamented this and sent Inner Attendant Zhang Tianxi to posthumously enfeoff Ruzuo as Military Commissioner of the Changwu Army with hereditary mouke rank for his descendants. An edict also ordered Xianshan commander Huyan Shi and Dengfeng commander Fan Zhen to join forces to punish Gao.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Aizong deeply lamented this and sent Inner Attendant Zhang Tianxi to posthumously enfeoff Ruzuo as Military Commissioner of the Changwu Army with hereditary mouke rank for his descendants. An edict also ordered Xianshan commander Huyan Shi and Dengfeng commander Fan Zhen to join forces to punish Gao.

sentences.zh: 天錫避峴山遠，先約範真，真以麾下李某者往，以撫諭軍民為名。

translations.literal: Tianxi, finding Xianshan too distant, first arranged with Fan Zhen; Zhen sent a certain Li under his command, in the name of pacifying army and people.
translations.idiomatic: Tianxi, finding Xianshan too distant, first arranged with Fan Zhen; Zhen sent a certain Li under his command, in the name of pacifying army and people.

sentences.zh: 皋率軍士迎于東門，知朝廷圖己，陰為之備，李猶豫不敢發。

translations.literal: Gao led soldiers to welcome them at the east gate. Knowing the court plotted against him, he secretly prepared; Li hesitated and dared not act.
translations.idiomatic: Gao led soldiers to welcome them at the east gate. Knowing the court plotted against him, he secretly prepared; Li hesitated and dared not act.

sentences.zh: 皋館天錫于望崧樓，隱毒於食，天錫遂中毒而死。

translations.literal: Gao lodged Tianxi at Wangsong Tower and hid poison in his food; Tianxi died of poisoning.
translations.idiomatic: Gao lodged Tianxi at Wangsong Tower and hid poison in his food; Tianxi died of poisoning.

sentences.zh: 皋後為大元兵所殺。

translations.literal: Gao was later killed by the Great Yuan army.
translations.idiomatic: Gao was later killed by the Great Yuan army.

sentences.zh: 楊鵬字飛卿，能詩。

translations.literal: Yang Peng, courtesy name Feiqing, could compose poetry.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Peng, courtesy name Feiqing, was a poet.

sentences.zh: 愛申，逸其族與名，或曰一名忙哥。

translations.literal: Ai Shen — his clan and personal name are lost; some say he was also called Mangge.
translations.idiomatic: Ai Shen — his clan and personal name are lost; some say he was also called Mangge.

sentences.zh: 本虢縣鎮防軍，累功遷軍中總領。

translations.literal: Originally of the garrison force in Guo County, he rose through merit to chief steward in the army.
translations.idiomatic: Originally of the garrison force in Guo County, he rose through merit to chief steward in the army.

sentences.zh: 李文秀據秦州，宣宗詔鳳翔軍討之，軍圍秦州城。

translations.literal: Li Wenxiu held Qinzhou; Emperor Xuanzong ordered the Fengxiang army to punish him, and the army besieged Qinzhou city.
translations.idiomatic: Li Wenxiu held Qinzhou; Emperor Xuanzong ordered the Fengxiang army to punish him, and the army besieged Qinzhou city.

sentences.zh: 時愛申在軍中，有罪當死。

translations.literal: At that time Ai Shen was in the army and had guilt deserving death.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Ai Shen was in the army and had guilt deserving death.

sentences.zh: 宣宗問之樞帥，有知其名者奏此人將帥材，忠實可倚。

translations.literal: Emperor Xuanzong asked the privy marshal; someone who knew his name memorialized that this man had the talent of a general and was loyal and dependable.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Xuanzong asked the privy marshal; someone who knew his name memorialized that this man had the talent of a general and was loyal and dependable.

sentences.zh: 宣宗命馳赦之，以為德順節度使、行元帥府事。

translations.literal: Emperor Xuanzong ordered a swift pardon and made him Military Commissioner of the Deshun Army, acting marshal's office affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Xuanzong ordered a swift pardon and made him Military Commissioner of the Deshun Army, acting marshal's headquarters affairs.

sentences.zh: 正大四年春，大兵西來，擬以德順為坐夏之所，德順無軍，人甚危之。

translations.literal: In the spring of Zhengda 4 the great army came from the west, intending to make Deshun its summer encampment. Deshun had no army, and people were greatly alarmed.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of Zhengda 4 the great army came from the west, intending to make Deshun its summer encampment. Deshun had no army, and people were greatly alarmed.

sentences.zh: 愛申識鳳翔馬肩龍舜卿者可與謀事，乃遺書招之，肩龍得書欲行，鳳翔總管禾速嘉國鑒以大兵方進，吾城可恃，德順決不可守，勸勿往。

translations.literal: Ai Shen knew that Ma Jianlong Shunqing of Fengxiang could be consulted in affairs, and sent a letter summoning him. Jianlong received the letter and wished to go, but Fengxiang overall commander Hesujia Guojian said the great army was advancing, our city could be relied on, and Deshun certainly could not be held — he urged him not to go.
translations.idiomatic: Ai Shen knew that Ma Jianlong Shunqing of Fengxiang could be consulted in affairs, and sent a letter summoning him. Jianlong received the letter and wished to go, but Fengxiang overall commander Hesujia Guojian said the great army was advancing, our city could be relied on, and Deshun certainly could not be held — he urged him not to go.

sentences.zh: 肩龍曰：「愛申平生未嘗識我，一見許為知己。

translations.literal: Jianlong said, "Ai Shen never knew me in his life, yet at one meeting he called me a true friend.
translations.idiomatic: Jianlong said, "Ai Shen never knew me in his life, yet at one meeting he called me a true friend.

sentences.zh: 我知德順不可守，往則必死，然以知己故。

translations.literal: I know Deshun cannot be held; if I go I will surely die, yet because he is a true friend,
translations.idiomatic: I know Deshun cannot be held; if I go I will surely die, yet because he is a true friend,

sentences.zh: 不得不為之死耳。」

translations.literal: I cannot but die for him."
translations.idiomatic: I must die for him."

sentences.zh: 乃舉行橐付族父，明為死別，冒險而去。

translations.literal: He then gave his traveling bag to a clan elder, clearly taking leave as one going to death, and set out at risk.
translations.idiomatic: He then gave his traveling bag to a clan elder, clearly taking leave as one going to death, and set out at risk.

sentences.zh: 既至，不數日受圍，城中惟有義兵鄉軍八九千人，大兵舉天下之勢攻之。

translations.literal: Once he arrived, within days they were besieged. In the city there were only eight or nine thousand volunteer and local troops; the great army attacked with the momentum of the whole realm.
translations.idiomatic: Once he arrived, within days they were besieged. In the city there were only eight or nine thousand volunteer and local troops; the great army attacked with the momentum of the whole realm.

sentences.zh: 愛申假舜卿鳳翔總管府判官，守禦一與共之。

translations.literal: Ai Shen borrowed Shunqing from the Fengxiang overall commander's office as judge, and they defended together as one.
translations.idiomatic: Ai Shen borrowed Shunqing from the Fengxiang overall commander's office as judge, and they defended together as one.

sentences.zh: 凡攻百二十晝夜，力盡乃破，愛申以劍自剄，時年五十三。

translations.literal: The assault lasted one hundred twenty days and nights; when strength was exhausted the city fell. Ai Shen cut his own throat with a sword; he was fifty-three.
translations.idiomatic: The assault lasted one hundred twenty days and nights; when strength was exhausted the city fell. Ai Shen cut his own throat with a sword; he was fifty-three.

sentences.zh: 軍中募生致肩龍，而不知所終。

translations.literal: The army offered a reward to capture Jianlong alive, but his end is unknown.
translations.idiomatic: The army offered a reward to capture Jianlong alive, but his end is unknown.

sentences.zh: 台諫有言當贈德順死事者官，以勸中外。

translations.literal: The censorate spoke of enfeoffing those who died in service at Deshun, to encourage within and without.
translations.idiomatic: The censorate spoke of enfeoffing those who died in service at Deshun, to encourage within and without.

sentences.zh: 詔各贈官，配食褒忠廟。

translations.literal: An edict posthumously enfeoffed each with rank and granted them sacrificial shares in the Hall of Loyal Merit.
translations.idiomatic: An edict posthumously enfeoffed each with rank and granted them sacrificial shares in the Hall of Loyal Merit.

sentences.zh: 馬肩龍

translations.literal: Ma Jianlong
translations.idiomatic: Ma Jianlong

translations.literal: (Supplementary)
translations.idiomatic: (Supplementary)

sentences.zh: 肩龍字舜卿，宛平人。

translations.literal: Jianlong, courtesy name Shunqing, was a man of Wanping.
translations.idiomatic: Jianlong, courtesy name Shunqing, came from Wanping.

sentences.zh: 先世遼大族，有知興中府者，故人號興中馬氏。

translations.literal: His forebears were a great clan of Liao; one served as administrator of Xingzhong Prefecture, so people called them the Ma clan of Xingzhong.
translations.idiomatic: His forebears were a great clan of Liao; one served as administrator of Xingzhong Prefecture, so people called them the Ma clan of Xingzhong.

sentences.zh: 祖大中，金初登科，節度全、錦兩州。

translations.literal: His grandfather Dazhong passed the examination at the beginning of Jin and served as military commissioner of Quan and Jin prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: His grandfather Dazhong passed the examination at the beginning of Jin and served as military commissioner of Quan and Jin prefectures.

sentences.zh: 父成誼，明昌五年登科，仕為京兆府路統軍司判官。

translations.literal: His father Chengyi passed the examination in Mingchang 5 and served as judge of the overall commander's office on the Jingzhao Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: His father Chengyi passed the examination in Mingchang 5 and served as judge of the overall commander's office on the Jingzhao Circuit.

sentences.zh: 肩龍在太學有賦聲。

translations.literal: Jianlong had a reputation for fu composition in the Imperial Academy.
translations.idiomatic: Jianlong had a reputation for fu composition in the Imperial Academy.

sentences.zh: 宣宗初，有誣宗室從坦殺人，將置之死。

translations.literal: Early in Emperor Xuanzong's reign, someone falsely accused the imperial clansman Cong Tan of murder, and he was about to be put to death.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Emperor Xuanzong's reign, someone falsely accused the imperial clansman Cong Tan of murder, and he was about to be put to death.

sentences.zh: 人不敢言其冤，肩龍上書，大略謂：「從坦有將帥材，少出其右者，臣一介書生，無用于世，願代從坦死，留為天子將兵。」

translations.literal: No one dared speak of his innocence. Jianlong submitted a memorial saying in substance: "Cong Tan has the talent of a general; few surpass him. I am a mere scholar, useless to the world — I wish to die in Cong Tan's place and remain to lead troops for the Son of Heaven."
translations.idiomatic: No one dared speak of his innocence. Jianlong submitted a memorial saying in substance: "Cong Tan has the talent of a general; few surpass him. I am a mere scholar, useless to the world — I wish to die in Cong Tan's place and remain to lead troops for the Son of Heaven."

sentences.zh: 書奏，詔問：「汝與從坦交分厚歟？」

translations.literal: When the memorial was submitted, an edict asked, "Are you and Cong Tan close friends?"
translations.idiomatic: When the memorial was submitted, an edict asked, "Are you and Cong Tan close friends?"

sentences.zh: 肩龍對曰：「臣知有從坦，從坦未嘗識臣。

translations.literal: Jianlong answered, "I know of Cong Tan; Cong Tan has never known me.
translations.idiomatic: Jianlong answered, "I know of Cong Tan; Cong Tan has never known me.

sentences.zh: 從坦冤人，不敢言，臣以死保之。」

translations.literal: Cong Tan is wronged, and no one dares speak; I guarantee him with my death."
translations.idiomatic: Cong Tan is wronged, and no one dares speak; I guarantee him with my death."

sentences.zh: 宣宗感悟，赦從坦，授肩龍東平錄事，委行省試驗。

translations.literal: Emperor Xuanzong was moved, pardoned Cong Tan, appointed Jianlong recorder of Dongping, and entrusted him to the branch secretariat for trial.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Xuanzong was moved, pardoned Cong Tan, appointed Jianlong recorder of Dongping, and entrusted him to the branch secretariat for trial.

sentences.zh: 宰相侯摯與語不契，留數月罷歸，將渡河，與排岸官紛競，搜篋中，得軍馬糧料名數及利害數事，疑其為奸人偵伺者，系歸德獄根勘。

translations.literal: Chief Councillor Hou Zhi did not agree with him in conversation; after several months he was dismissed and sent home. About to cross the river, he quarreled with the wharf officer; searching his case they found lists of army horses and grain and several matters of strategic advantage, suspected him of being a spy, and imprisoned him in Guide for thorough investigation.
translations.idiomatic: Chief Councillor Hou Zhi did not agree with him in conversation; after several months he was dismissed and sent home. About to cross the river, he quarreled with the wharf officer; searching his case they found lists of army horses and grain and several matters of strategic advantage, suspected him of being a spy, and imprisoned him in Guide for thorough investigation.

sentences.zh: 適從坦至，立救出之。

translations.literal: Cong Tan happened to arrive and at once rescued him.
translations.idiomatic: Cong Tan happened to arrive and at once rescued him.

sentences.zh: 正大三年，客鳳翔，元帥愛申深器重之，至是，同死於難。

translations.literal: In Zhengda 3 he was a guest at Fengxiang; Marshal Ai Shen deeply valued him, and at this time they died together in the disaster.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhengda 3 he was a guest at Fengxiang; Marshal Ai Shen deeply valued him, and at this time they died together in the disaster.

sentences.zh: 禹顯，雁門人。

translations.literal: Yu Xian was a man of Yanmen.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Xian came from Yanmen.

sentences.zh: 貞祐初，隸上党公張開，累以戰功授義勝軍節度使、兼沁州招撫副使。

translations.literal: Early in Zhenyou he served under Duke Shangdang Zhang Kai and through repeated battle merit was appointed Military Commissioner of the Yisheng Army and concurrent vice pacification commissioner of Qin Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Zhenyou he served under Duke Shangdang Zhang Kai and through repeated battle merit was appointed Military Commissioner of the Yisheng Army and concurrent vice pacification commissioner of Qin Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 元光二年四月，大帥達兒泬、按察兒攻河東，張開遣顯扼龍豬穀，夾攻敗之，擒元帥韓光國，獲輜重甲仗甚眾，追至祁縣而還，所曆州縣悉複之。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of Yuanguang 2, supreme commanders Da'erbo and Ancha'er attacked Hedong. Zhang Kai sent Xian to hold Longzhu Valley; attacking from both sides they defeated the enemy, captured Marshal Han Guangguo, took a great quantity of baggage, armor, and weapons, pursued to Qi County and returned, and recovered all prefectures and counties they passed through.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the second year of Yuanguang, supreme commanders Da'erbo and Ancha'er attacked Hedong. Zhang Kai sent Xian to hold Longzhu Valley; attacking from both sides they defeated the enemy, captured Marshal Han Guangguo, took a great quantity of baggage, armor, and weapons, pursued to Qi County and returned, and recovered all prefectures and counties they passed through.

sentences.zh: 顯將軍三百人，守襄垣，八年不遷。

translations.literal: Xian commanded three hundred soldiers and held Xiangyuan for eight years without transfer.
translations.idiomatic: Xian commanded three hundred soldiers and held Xiangyuan for eight years without transfer.

sentences.zh: 大帥嘗集河朔步騎數萬攻之，至於數四不能拔。

translations.literal: The supreme commander once gathered tens of thousands of infantry and cavalry from Hebei to attack it; four times they could not take it.
translations.idiomatic: The supreme commander once gathered tens of thousands of infantry and cavalry from Hebei to attack it; four times they could not take it.

sentences.zh: 既而，戰于玉女寨，大獲。

translations.literal: Later they fought at Yunu Stockade and won a great victory.
translations.idiomatic: Later they fought at Yunu Stockade and won a great victory.

sentences.zh: 開言于朝，權元帥右都監。

translations.literal: Kai spoke to the court, and Xian was made acting Marshal Right Vice Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Kai spoke to the court, and Xian was made acting Marshal Right Vice Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 正大六年冬十二月，軍內變，城破被擒。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of winter in Zhengda 6 there was mutiny within the army; the city fell and he was captured.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of winter in Zhengda 6 there was mutiny within the army; the city fell and he was captured.

sentences.zh: 帥義之，不欲加害。

translations.literal: The commander admired his righteousness and did not wish to harm him.
translations.idiomatic: The commander admired his righteousness and did not wish to harm him.

sentences.zh: 初以鐵繩鈐之，既而密與舊部曲二十人遁去，聞上黨公軍複振，將往從之。

translations.literal: At first he was bound with iron chains; soon he secretly escaped with twenty old followers. Hearing that Duke Shangdang's army had revived, he meant to go join them.
translations.idiomatic: At first he was bound with iron chains; soon he secretly escaped with twenty old followers. Hearing that Duke Shangdang's army had revived, he meant to go join them.

sentences.zh: 大兵四向來追，顯適與負釜一兵相失，乞飯山寺中，僧走報焉，被執不屈死，時年四十一。

translations.literal: Northern troops pursued from all four directions. Xian happened to lose contact with a soldier carrying a cauldron; begging food at a mountain temple, a monk ran to report him; captured, he would not yield and died; he was forty-one.
translations.idiomatic: Northern troops pursued from all four directions. Xian happened to lose contact with a soldier carrying a cauldron; begging food at a mountain temple, a monk ran to report him; captured, he would not yield and died; he was forty-one.

sentences.zh: 張邦憲

translations.literal: Zhang Bangxian
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Bangxian

sentences.zh: 秦州人張邦憲，字正叔，登正大中進士第，為永固令。

translations.literal: Zhang Bangxian of Qinzhou, courtesy name Zhengshu, passed the jinshi examination in the middle of Zhengda and served as magistrate of Yonggu.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Bangxian of Qinzhou, courtesy name Zhengshu, passed the jinshi examination in the middle of Zhengda and served as magistrate of Yonggu.

sentences.zh: 天興二年，避兵徐州。

translations.literal: In Tianxing 2 he fled war to Xuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In Tianxing 2 he fled war to Xuzhou.

sentences.zh: 卓翼率兵至城，邦憲被執，將驅之北，邦憲罵曰：「我進士也，誤蒙朝廷用為邑長，可從汝曹反耶！」

translations.literal: Zhuo Yi led troops to the city; Bangxian was captured and about to be driven north. Bangxian cursed, "I am a jinshi — wrongly favored by the court as district chief; how could I follow you lot in rebellion!"
translations.idiomatic: Zhuo Yi led troops to the city; Bangxian was captured and about to be driven north. Bangxian cursed, "I am a jinshi — wrongly favored by the court as district chief; how could I follow you lot in rebellion!"

sentences.zh: 遂遇害。

translations.literal: He was then killed.
translations.idiomatic: He was then killed.

sentences.zh: 劉全者，彭城民也。

translations.literal: Liu Quan was a commoner of Pengcheng.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Quan was a commoner of Pengcheng.

sentences.zh: 率鄉鄰數百避兵沫溝，推為砦主。

translations.literal: He led several hundred neighbors to flee war to Mogou and was made stockade chief.
translations.idiomatic: He led several hundred neighbors to flee war to Mogou and was made stockade chief.

sentences.zh: 北兵至徐，盡俘其老幼，全父亦在其中，北兵質之以招全，全縛其人送徐州，因竊其父以歸。

translations.literal: When Northern troops reached Xu, they captured all the old and young; Quan's father was among them. The Northern army held him hostage to win Quan over; Quan bound their man and sent him to Xuzhou, then stole his father back.
translations.idiomatic: When Northern troops reached Xu, they captured all the old and young; Quan's father was among them. The Northern army held him hostage to win Quan over; Quan bound their man and sent him to Xuzhou, then stole his father back.

sentences.zh: 徐帥益都嘉其忠，承制以為昭信校尉，遙領彭城縣尉。

translations.literal: The Xuzhou commander Yidu praised his loyalty and, acting on his own authority, made him Colonel of Manifest Trust with honorary status as assistant magistrate of Pengcheng County.
translations.idiomatic: The Xuzhou commander Yidu praised his loyalty and, acting on his own authority, made him Colonel of Manifest Trust with honorary status as assistant magistrate of Pengcheng County.

sentences.zh: 後遇國用安，怒其不附己，見殺。

translations.literal: Later he encountered Guo Yong'an, who was angry that he would not attach himself to him, and had him killed.
translations.idiomatic: Later he encountered Guo Yong'an, who was angry that he would not attach himself to him, and had him killed.
